strongest_long_setup: RSI 58-63 with DI+ exceeding DI- by 14+ points and sentiment neutral (+0.12 to +0.17); achieves 67% win rate. Secondary setup: positive MACD with RSI < 55 shows 71% win rate but fewer occurrences.
strongest_short_setup: Insufficient edge detected. SHORT trades show 43% win rate at best. Data suggests SHORT direction is fundamentally weaker for this asset; recommend deprioritizing shorts or requiring significantly higher confidence thresholds.
summary: LONG trades dominate profitability when RSI stays in 58-63 range with strong DI+ advantage, but extreme sentiment readings (>+0.50) and high ADX (>30) trigger reversals. HIGH ADX paradoxically correlates with losses despite indicating trend strength, suggesting SOL mean-reverts in strong trends. SHORT trades lack reliable edge across all conditions tested; focus capital on optimized LONG setups with neutral-to-slightly-positive sentiment. DNE signal miss rate of 36.8% indicates signals may be appropriately cautious rather than overly conservative.
